answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on popular mathematical reasoning benchmarks: (1) GSM8K, (2) MultiArith, (3) SVAMP, (4) MAWPS, and (5) CoinFlips... Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ThoughtProbe consistently outperforms existing inference-time computing methods.
